easy: A kind and friendly feeling toward other people.

easy: Happening slowly, a little bit at a time.

easy: A person who changes writing from one language into another.

easy: Thick, stiff paper used to make boxes.

easy: In a relaxed way, as if it does not matter.

ex.ko: 엄마는 집 안에서 공놀이를 못 하게 하신다.

easy: How confident and happy you feel about what you are doing.

easy: The feeling that good things will happen.

easy: Too old to be used or in style anymore.

easy: A mix of oxygen and another thing.

easy: When something is found in many places.

easy: The ball used to play a game like baseball.

easy: Toward or in the direction between south and east.

easy: A sweet, dark purple berry.

ex.ko: 나는 덤불에서 즙이 많은 블랙베리를 땄다.

easy: Making a humming sound like a bee.

ex.en: The buzzing bees flew around the flowers.
